hunks.baseline: For a very brief moment, every thought in my head ground to a halt.
hunks.sol: For a moment, every thought in my head stopped.

hunks.baseline: I stared, mouth hanging open, at the scene in the distance.
hunks.sol: I stared, mouth open, at the scene in the distance.

hunks.baseline: The Fire Dragon Pavilion members were running toward me, panic written all over their faces.
hunks.sol: The Fire Dragon Pavilion members were running toward me, panic written all over their faces. A group of black-clad figures was racing after them.

hunks.baseline: And a group was charging after them at full speed.

The ground shook. The figures were dressed in black from head to toe, and even the ones I could see right then numbered well over a thousand. The more clearly I felt their chilling aura as they drew closer, the more obvious one thing became.
hunks.sol: The ground shook. Even the figures I could see numbered well over a thousand, all dressed in black from head to toe. As they drew closer, their chilling aura grew clearer. It could mean only one thing.

hunks.baseline: A red warning light flashed in my mind at the same moment I reached that conclusion.
hunks.sol: The instant I reached that conclusion, a red warning light flashed in my mind.

hunks.baseline: I had no idea what was going on, but what I needed to do now was clear.
hunks.sol: I had no idea what had happened, but what I needed to do was clear.

hunks.baseline: The battlefield had fallen into a momentary lull at the appearance of the unknown black-clad figures. I shouted into the quiet.
More precisely, I shouted at the Embroidered Uniform Guards.
hunks.sol: The unknown figures had brought the battlefield to a momentary lull. I shouted at the Embroidered Uniform Guards.

hunks.baseline: “Quit standing there with your jaws hanging open and pick up your weapons!”
hunks.sol: “Quit standing there and pick up your weapons!”

hunks.baseline: Of course, I didn’t expect the Embroidered Uniform Guards to obediently follow my orders just because I’d given them. But right beside me was a man of high standing—a Thousand Captain of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, no less.
hunks.sol: I didn’t expect them to obey me just because I’d given an order. But beside me stood a man of considerable rank—a Thousand Captain of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.

hunks.baseline: Flames burst from my toes, scorching the air.
Riding the shock wave from the explosion, I took a step, then another. In an instant, the distance of twenty-odd *jang* vanished, and the shadows atop the stone wall drew near.
hunks.sol: Flames burst from my toes, scorching the air. Riding the shock wave, I took one step, then another. The twenty-odd *jang* between me and the stone wall vanished, and the figures atop it came into view.

hunks.baseline: Along with the Embroidered Uniform Guard, they were one of the Great Nation’s elite forces, charged with protecting the imperial capital. They were also traitors who’d betrayed the Emperor and taken refuge in the shadow of the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, who had lived behind the guise of Cang Gong.
hunks.sol: Along with the Embroidered Uniform Guard, they were one of the Great Nation’s elite forces charged with protecting the Imperial Capital. Now they were traitors who had turned against the Emperor and taken refuge under the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord—the man who had lived behind the guise of Cang Gong.

hunks.baseline: The archers who’d hidden behind the towering stone wall and fired arrow after arrow had now turned their bows toward the Fire Dragon Pavilion members, who had appeared behind them alongside the black-clad figures.
hunks.sol: From behind the high stone wall, they had been firing arrows without pause. Their bows were now aimed at the Fire Dragon Pavilion members who had appeared behind them alongside the black-clad figures.

hunks.baseline: At least, that was where they’d been aiming before I arrived.
hunks.sol: At least, they were until I arrived.

hunks.baseline: At the urgent call of someone who looked like a junior officer, a middle-aged man in ornate armor swung the baton in his hand without hesitation.
hunks.sol: At the urgent call of someone who looked like a junior officer, a middle-aged man in ornate armor raised the baton in his hand. He pointed it toward me as I closed the dozens of *jang* between us.

hunks.baseline: He swung it at me as I closed the dozens of *jang* between us in an instant.
hunks.sol: After a brief hesitation, he gave the order.

hunks.baseline: The order came after a brief moment of hesitation.
A full thousand archers turned and released their taut bowstrings.
Countless silver arrowheads, imbued with internal energy, blanketed the sky as they came raining down on me.
hunks.sol: Nearly a thousand archers turned and released their taut bowstrings. Countless silver arrowheads, imbued with internal energy, blanketed the sky as they rained down on me.

hunks.baseline: A near-perfect volley, with enough power that even a Supreme Peak master couldn’t afford to ignore it.
hunks.sol: It was a near-perfect volley, powerful enough that even a Supreme Peak master couldn’t ignore it.

hunks.baseline: *If they don’t hit their target, they’re useless.*
hunks.sol: *Not if they can’t hit me.*

hunks.baseline: With another burst of flame from my toes, I shot forward like a cannonball.
hunks.sol: Another burst of flame exploded from my toes, and I shot forward like a cannonball.

hunks.baseline: A sudden burst of speed. Then a swerve.
hunks.sol: A sudden burst of speed. A swerve.

hunks.baseline: A fierce, chilling whistle of arrows rang out behind me.
I didn’t bother looking back, but I could tell from the sound alone that the spot where I’d stood a moment ago was now covered in arrows.
hunks.sol: Arrows whistled past behind me with a sound that made my skin crawl. I didn’t need to look back to know that the spot where I’d stood a moment ago was bristling with them.

hunks.baseline: And I knew the Imperial Guards, one of the Great Nation’s elite forces, wouldn’t stop attacking after just that.
hunks.sol: Nor did I think the Imperial Guards, one of the Great Nation’s elite forces, would stop there.

hunks.baseline: Their surprise at my speed lasted only a moment. The Imperial Guards under the commander’s control had been trained thoroughly. They nocked new arrows and loosed them in a smooth, swift rhythm.
hunks.sol: Their surprise at my speed lasted only a moment. Thoroughly trained, the Imperial Guards nocked new arrows and fired in one swift, fluid motion.

hunks.baseline: And just as I narrowly evaded the fourth rain of arrows, shot in two successive waves—
hunks.sol: I narrowly evaded the fourth rain of arrows, loosed in two successive waves.

hunks.baseline: I kicked off the ground and shot into the air. The Imperial Guards were already nocking the fifth and final volley when their screams broke out.
hunks.sol: Then I kicked off the ground and shot into the air. The Imperial Guards were nocking their fifth volley—the last they would get to fire—when they cried out.

hunks.baseline: It all happened in the blink of an eye.
The four volleys had been fired in barely any time at all. And I’d crossed that thick storm of arrows to reach the top of the stone wall just as quickly.
hunks.sol: It all happened in an instant: four volleys, and my passage through that dense storm of arrows to the top of the stone wall.

hunks.baseline: In the world that had slowed to a crawl, a few of the most alert Imperial Guards had reacted to the order and loosed their arrows at me. The arrows cut through space.
hunks.sol: In the world that had slowed around me, a few of the quickest Imperial Guards obeyed the order. Their arrows cut through the air toward me.

hunks.baseline: Very slowly. Slowly enough that I could hear the wind rushing along each advancing arrowhead.
hunks.sol: Slowly. So slowly that I could hear the wind flowing along each advancing arrowhead.

hunks.baseline: I reached out toward the dozens of arrows flashing in the darkness, each imbued with internal energy.
hunks.sol: I reached toward the dozens of arrows flashing in the darkness, each imbued with internal energy. At the same time, I awakened the pulse I alone could feel at the center of my chest, at the point called the Jade Hall.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, I stirred my quiet heartbeat—the pulse I alone could sense at the very center of my chest, in the spot called the Jade Hall.
An invisible force—an unknown power on a completely different plane from internal energy—spread out in every direction at my will.

hunks.baseline: It erased the wind, stilled the air, and caught the dozens of arrows moving sluggishly through it.
hunks.sol: An invisible power, utterly unlike internal energy, spread in every direction at my will. It erased the wind, stilled the air, and caught the dozens of arrows moving through it.

hunks.baseline: The air trembled. Time, which had slowed, returned to its normal pace.
hunks.sol: The air trembled. Time returned to its normal pace.

hunks.baseline: But the Imperial Guards looking up at me, standing upright in midair, could only stare, their faces frozen in shock.
hunks.sol: But the Imperial Guards looking up at me, standing in midair, remained frozen in shock.

hunks.baseline: The groan that slipped from someone’s lips broke the heavy silence.
In their wide eyes, bulging as if they might pop out, the dozens of arrows hanging in midair—as though caught by an invisible hand—and me at their center were reflected in full.
hunks.sol: Someone’s groan broke the heavy silence. Reflected in their wide, staring eyes were dozens of arrows suspended as though caught by an invisible hand, with me at their center.

hunks.baseline: Shock and fear. Questions only those who’d witnessed something close to incomprehensible could ask.
hunks.sol: Shock. Fear. The questions of men who had seen something they couldn’t comprehend.

hunks.baseline: And lastly, the desperate resistance of a few who still hadn’t given up.
hunks.sol: And then came the desperate resistance of the few who hadn’t given up.

hunks.baseline: I shot my hand out like a bolt of lightning toward the few officers screaming at their men.
hunks.sol: I thrust out my hand toward the officers shouting themselves hoarse.

hunks.baseline: Or, to be exact, I scattered the arrows I’d been holding with the power of my Middle Dantian.
hunks.sol: Or, more precisely, I sent the arrows I’d caught with the power of my Middle Dantian flying toward them.

hunks.baseline: Screams rang out after the arrows’ fierce whistle.
hunks.sol: Screams followed the arrows’ fierce whistle.

hunks.baseline: True to their reputation as Imperial Guards, each of them was a master of no small skill. But they couldn’t dodge the arrows I sent flying as if I were controlling them.
hunks.sol: The Imperial Guards had earned their reputation. Each was a skilled master in his own right, but none could dodge the arrows I sent at them.

hunks.baseline: Except for one man.
hunks.sol: Except one.

hunks.baseline: Arrows bounced away in a flash of swordlight.
hunks.sol: Arrows flew aside in a flash of swordlight.

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man had cut down the attacks coming at him from all sides in a single sweep, his Force shining as brilliantly as the ornate armor that set him apart from every other Imperial Guard. A thought flashed through my mind, and I let it slip out.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man cut down the attacks converging on him from every direction in a single sweep. His Force shone as brilliantly as the armor that set him apart from the other Imperial Guards. A thought crossed my mind, and I said it aloud.

hunks.baseline: The Twelve Palaces of the Zodiac.

hunks.baseline: The title collectively referring to the twelve Supreme Peak masters who represented the imperial court.
hunks.sol: The Twelve Palaces of the Zodiac: the collective title for the twelve Supreme Peak masters who represented the imperial court.

hunks.baseline: *“It’s also what they call the twelve Supreme Peak masters who represent the imperial capital. And half of them are on our side.”*
hunks.sol: *“It’s also what they call the twelve Supreme Peak masters who represent the Imperial Capital. And half of them are on our side.”*
Ma Sanbao had told me that himself.

hunks.baseline: It was one of the things Ma Sanbao had told me himself. The middle-aged man looked at me with a grave expression and tightened his grip on his great saber.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man fixed me with a grave look and tightened his grip on his great saber.

hunks.baseline: “You’re the treacherous piece of shit who betrayed the Emperor and sided with Dark Heaven. The asshole who wanted to turn me and my people into pincushions. And the asshole who’s about to die.”
hunks.sol: “You’re the treacherous piece of shit who betrayed the Emperor and sided with Dark Heaven. The asshole who tried to turn me and my people into pincushions. And the asshole who’s about to die.”

hunks.baseline: “That seems like enough to me. If you need more explanation, spit it out.”
hunks.sol: “That about covers it. If you need to add anything, spit it out yourself.”

hunks.baseline: “……No. That’s enough. Except for one thing.”
hunks.sol: “…No. That’s enough. Except for one thing.”

hunks.baseline: With a sharp gleam in his eyes, the middle-aged man added quietly,
“I’m not the one who’s going to die.”
hunks.sol: His eyes gleamed as he added quietly, “I’m not the one who’s going to die.”

hunks.baseline: The man’s figure blurred.
hunks.sol: His figure blurred.

hunks.baseline: Shifting Form and Position, a supreme movement technique that only those who’d reached the highest realms could perform.
hunks.sol: Shifting Form and Position: a supreme movement technique available only to those who had reached the highest realms.

hunks.baseline: The moment he kicked off the stone wall and sprang into the air, his great saber—longer and larger than most men—crossed the space between us in a flash.
hunks.sol: He kicked off the stone wall and sprang into the air. His great saber, longer and larger than most grown men, flashed across the space between us.

hunks.baseline: Speed and power that left nothing wanting in a superhuman.

hunks.baseline: And the terrifying aura pouring from the Force wrapped tightly around the blade.
hunks.sol: Its speed and power were worthy of a superhuman. Terrifying energy poured from the Force wrapped around the blade.

hunks.baseline: I could tell at a glance how powerful this nameless middle-aged man was. I could also tell how grueling the training must have been that brought him to this realm and made him the commander of the Imperial Guards.
hunks.sol: I could tell at a glance how powerful this nameless man was. I could imagine the grueling training it had taken to reach his realm and become commander of the Imperial Guards.

hunks.baseline: But that was exactly why his great saber could never touch me.
hunks.sol: But that was precisely why his saber would never touch me.

hunks.baseline: To take in the scenery of an entire mountain range at a glance meant you were looking down at it from higher up.
hunks.sol: If you could take in an entire mountain range at a glance, you had to be looking down from higher up.

hunks.baseline: A single step. That was all it took.
hunks.sol: One step was enough.

hunks.baseline: The great saber tore through distorted space, but it couldn’t match my speed as I moved through the air as if it were solid ground. Only the strands of Force it sent flying barely grazed me.
hunks.sol: The great saber tore through the space I’d occupied, unable to catch me as I moved through the air as though it were solid ground. Only the strands of Force streaming from it grazed my body.

hunks.baseline: The powerful pressure split the skin showing through my already-tattered clothes. It burst open, scattering drops of my blood.
hunks.sol: The pressure split the skin exposed beneath my tattered clothes. Drops of my blood scattered through the air and mingled with someone else’s.

hunks.baseline: They mingled with someone else’s.
With a wet, phlegmy sound, the middle-aged man’s body quivered. Something that hadn’t been there moments ago jutted from his thick, bull-like neck.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man’s body shuddered with a wet, rattling sound. Something that hadn’t been there a moment ago protruded from his thick, bull-like neck.

hunks.baseline: Something glinting coldly in the darkness.
hunks.sol: Something that glinted coldly in the dark.

hunks.baseline: Even as he struggled to maintain Stepping on Empty Air, he fumbled at the arrowhead, unable to believe what had happened. I looked at him calmly.
hunks.sol: He could barely maintain Stepping on Empty Air. Still, he felt for the arrowhead, as though he couldn’t believe it was there. I watched him calmly.

hunks.baseline: “I’ve been getting so many unexpected gifts that I started feeling bad. I’ll return one of them. Take it.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve received so many unexpected gifts that I was starting to feel bad. Here, you can have one back.”

hunks.baseline: I touched the center of his unsteady chest with my finger and continued.
hunks.sol: I touched the center of his swaying chest with a finger.

hunks.baseline: “But it’s much harder—and a lot more certain.”
hunks.sol: “Much harder, though. And more certain.”

hunks.baseline: “……The Middle Dantian. It’s the Middle Dantian.”
hunks.sol: “…The Middle Dantian. It’s the Middle Dantian.”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man spat out a mouthful of blood and looked at me with trembling eyes.
Then, with what little strength he had left, he struggled to raise the great saber he still clutched.
hunks.sol: He spat out a mouthful of blood and looked at me, his eyes trembling. Then, with his last strength, he struggled to raise the great saber he still held.

hunks.baseline: His voice fading, he said,
hunks.sol: His voice faded as he spoke.

hunks.baseline: “I… I am the Golden Ox Palace of the Twelve Palaces of the Zodiac, the Chief Commander of the Imperial Guard, and one who gives his life to the great and almighty Lord of Heaven…”
hunks.sol: “I… I am the Golden Ox Palace of the Twelve Palaces of the Zodiac, the Chief Commander of the Imperial Guards, and one who devotes his life to the great and almighty Lord of Heaven…”

hunks.baseline: The rest of his words would never be spoken.
hunks.sol: He never finished.

hunks.baseline: Was it the great saber sliding from his hand that happened first?
hunks.sol: Did the saber slide from his hand first? Or did his body tip as death closed in?

hunks.baseline: Or his body, tipping over as death loomed darkly before his eyes?
I didn’t know which hit the ground first. I didn’t care to know.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know which struck the ground first. I didn’t care.

hunks.baseline: Master and weapon fell as one. Then, as the dull thud rose from the ground below, I stepped onto the stone wall.
hunks.sol: Man and weapon fell together. As a dull thud rose from below, I stepped onto the stone wall.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, into the middle of the Imperial Guards, who stood frozen like statues.
hunks.sol: Right into the middle of the Imperial Guards, who stood frozen like statues.

hunks.baseline: Someone sucked in a breath. A whirl of emotions rose from the countless men crowding the top of the wall.
Fear and anger, shock. And, last of all, confusion at not knowing what to do.
hunks.sol: Someone caught his breath. The men crowding the wall were a tumult of fear, anger, shock—and, finally, confusion over what to do.

hunks.baseline: And that confusion could only mean one thing.
hunks.sol: That confusion could mean only one thing.

hunks.baseline: There were thousands of traitors on this battlefield alone.

No matter how long the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord had served in the imperial court under the name Cang Gong, it was clear that not all these men had been raised as Dark Heaven’s dogs from the beginning.
hunks.sol: There were thousands of traitors on this battlefield alone. No matter how long the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord had lived in the imperial court as Cang Gong, they couldn’t all have been raised as Dark Heaven’s dogs from the start.

hunks.baseline: The Great Nation’s imperial court wasn’t that easy to fool.
hunks.sol: The Great Nation’s imperial court wasn’t so easily fooled.

hunks.baseline: *Winning them over. Coercion. Or orders they couldn’t refuse.*
hunks.sol: *They were won over. Coerced. Or given orders they couldn’t refuse.*

hunks.baseline: Dark Heaven had probably broken them in that way. And now the carrots and sticks they’d used were in my hands.
hunks.sol: That was probably how Dark Heaven had brought them into line. Now I had their carrots and sticks in my hands.

hunks.baseline: “There’s one thing I can promise you, at least.”
hunks.sol: “There’s one thing I can promise you.”

hunks.baseline: I spoke up abruptly, then addressed all the Imperial Guards.
hunks.sol: I addressed all the Imperial Guards.

hunks.baseline: “If you side with the imperial court now, I’ll make sure you don’t end up as traitors, one way or another.”
hunks.sol: “If you side with the imperial court now, I’ll find some way to keep you from being branded traitors.”

hunks.baseline: As soon as I finished speaking, I reached out.

hunks.baseline: Toward the Imperial Guard officer who was approaching unseen from a blind spot, his killing intent clear.
hunks.sol: As soon as I finished speaking, I reached out toward an Imperial Guard officer approaching from a blind spot, his killing intent unmistakable.

hunks.baseline: A streak of air whistled by, and one more corpse hit the ground.
hunks.sol: Something whistled through the air. There was one more corpse on the wall.

hunks.baseline: I pointed at the body lying there, a Finger Qi hole through its brow, and added calmly,
hunks.sol: I pointed to the officer lying there with his brow pierced by Finger Qi.

hunks.baseline: “Anyone here who doesn’t like my offer, raise your hand.”
hunks.sol: “Anyone who doesn’t like my offer, raise your hand.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, I didn’t forget one last thing I absolutely had to say.
hunks.sol: But I didn’t forget one last thing they needed to hear.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, and if you see someone who’s a real bastard, cut him down right now.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, and if there’s someone you know is a real bastard, cut him down right now.”

hunks.baseline: I left the Imperial Guards glancing at one another and ran toward the Fire Dragon Pavilion members fleeing from the mysterious black-clad figures.
hunks.sol: I left the Imperial Guards glancing at one another and ran toward the Fire Dragon Pavilion members fleeing the unknown black-clad figures.
